name: STC-248GE.docx
path: Realtek Based Commercial Switch/Commercial Ethernet Switch/STC-248GE.docx
method: python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Introduction
It adopts high-quality and high-speed network intelligent chip and completely solves the noise problem when deploying small switches in the office environment through the fan-less mute design
This switch has 2 Gigabit SFP and 48 Gigabit RJ45 ports enjoying
seamless connection for 10/100/1000M Ethernet
two working modes
easy to manage and maintain, intelligent one-click dialing
It can be widely used in security network video surveillance, hotel, campus, small and medium-sized enterprise network engineering and other occasions
Key Features
48*10/100/1000M RJ45 Ports+2*1000M SFP Ports
Comply with IEEE 802.3, IEEE 802.3u, IEEE802.3ab standards
Ethernet port supports 10/100/1000M adaptive
Support auto MDI/ MDIX
Panel indicators to monitor working status and help fault analysis
Support dial switch VLAN mode
Flow control, full duplex adopts IEEE802.3x standard, half duplex adopts Back pressure standard
Support loop alarm
Surge Protection: General 6KV, Differential 2KV, ESD 15KV air, 8KV contact(level B)
Specification
Product Name	50 Port 10/100/1000Mbps Rack Type Ethernet Switch
Port	48x10/100/1000M UTP RJ45(Support MDI/MDIX, auto-sensing)
2x1000M SFP Ports
Switching Capacity	100Gbps
Throughput	74.4Mpps
Packet Buffer	16M
MAC Address	32K
Jumbo Frame	12Kbytes
Transfer Mode	Store and forward
MTBF	100000 hours
Network Protocol	IEEE802.3(Ethernet) / IEEE802.3u(Fast Ethernet) / IEEE 802.3ab(Gigabit Ethernet) / IEEE802.3x(Flow Control)
Industry Standard	EMI: FCC Part 15 CISPR(EN55032)class A / EMS: EN61000-4-2(ESD) / EN61000-4-5(Surge)
Network Medium	10Base-T: Cat3, 4, 5 or above UTP( ≤100m) / 100Base-TX: Cat5 or above UTP( ≤100m) / 1000Base-TX: Cat5 or above UTP( ≤100m)
Optical Media	Multi mode fiber : 50/125, 62.5/125, 100/140μm / Single mode fiber: 8/125, 8.7/125, 9/125, 10/125μm
Certification	CE/FCC/RoHS
Working Environment	Working Temperature: -10℃~50℃ / Storage Temperature: -40℃~70℃ / Working Humidity: 10%~90%, non-condensing / Storage Temperature: 5%~95%, non-condensing
Input Voltage	AC100-240V, Single Power Input / Power supply: 12V4A
LED Indicators	PWR(Power indicator)
Lighting/Powered, Off/No-power / SYS(System Light) / On/The system is normal / Flashing/System startup in progress / Off/System not started / Link/Act(Link & Data) / Green On/1000M Link Connection Normal / Yellow On/10/100M Link Connection Normal / Flashing/Data Transmit / Off/Link Connection Blocked
VLAN Dialing	VLAN OFF/Off, all ports are interconnected / VLAN ON/enabled, ports 1-46 are isolated from each other and interconnected with ports 47-50
Dimension
Remark
Please contact us if the source file is needed
Packing Information
1pc switch(neutral device)
1pc power cable(standards vary across countries)
1pc user manual(including QIG information)
1pair mounting brackets(rack mountable)
Please know that there is NOT a warranty card in the packing box
A “Warranty Certificate” will be issued to indicate the order information and warranty coverage
Shipping box information(Below information is approximately accurate)
Product size: 440*205*44.5mm
Inner box size: 500*290*85mm
Product weight: 2.83Kg
Packing weight: 3.37Kg
Master box size: 520*445*310mm
Packing quantity: 5Pcs
Packing weight: 17.85Kg
Remark
Accessories(optical module, patchcord etc.)are NOT included in the packing box
Please prepare it by yourself or purchase a whole set from us
Power cable is included in BOTH the packing box AND unit pricing

Remark
